def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    r=next(i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if any(row))
    # A 2 extends upward four cells; an 8 extends upward three cells.
    for c,v in enumerate(grid[r]):
        if v in (2,8):
            height=4 if v==2 else 3
            top=max(0,r-height)
            out[top][c]=v
            for rr in range(top+1,r):
                out[rr][c]=1
    return out
PY
